summary: Elevate your tourism and hospitality skills with our Influencer Marketing training course. Learn to leverage social media for maximum impact and engagement.
lede: Influencer marketing in tourism and hospitality helps turn partnerships into structured campaigns built for qualified attention, bookings, inquiries, and loyalty. You will learn to assess influencers by audience fit and conversion potential rather than follower counts or aesthetics alone. The course covers campaign briefs, contracts, content approvals, performance tracking, conversion measurement, crisis handling, and reporting. It prepares you to justify investment while working within seasonal pressures, tight budgets, brand guidelines, and stakeholder expectations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals across the tourism and hospitality industry who are responsible for driving bookings and enhancing brand visibility through influencer marketing.
audience: Safari, adventure, and experiential travel companies
PR and communications professionals in travel
modules: Foundations of Influencer Marketing for Tourism and Hospitality
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of digital marketing principles and experience in the tourism or hospitality industry.
